title: The Weighing Hour
logline: A dealer's flat, expert glance under a loupe meets a family who has carried one stone a long way, hoping.
human_question: Why does the calm, unexcited offer sometimes carry more weight than the hopeful one?

situation.what_happens: A family brings a single find to people who buy such things for a living and have seen thousands of them. The examination is short and gives nothing away. A price is named, argued over, and either taken or refused, after which the family either goes home with money or carries the same stone to the next buyer. Everything the family has riding on it is visible; almost nothing the buyer has riding on it is.
situation.who_is_involved: A family whose year may turn on one find, and who do not know what it is worth; dealers who appraise all day and will see another tomorrow; the middlemen and relatives who came along to advise.
situation.what_is_at_stake: For the family, a sum that is either transforming or disappointing, and no way of knowing which offer was fair. For the dealer, one of many small margins and a reputation in a trade that runs on trust. For the film, the risk of making dealers into villains, which would be defamatory in effect and untrue.
situation.how_it_unfolds: These exchanges are short and repeat: an appraisal, a silence, a number, a counter, and a decision made with incomplete information on one side. They end in a sale, a refusal, or a slow walk to the next buyer, and the family usually never learns what the thing was really worth. Nothing about the price can be arranged, and the outcome belongs to the trade.

concept_merge.why_together: C006 contributes the contrast the exchange is built on: the sources sort greed-rooted minds by joyful or flat feeling, and rank the flat, unexcited kind as stronger than the joyful one, which is the reverse of what most people would expect. C021 contributes the appraiser's side: decision, which settles firmly on something whether or not it is right, and effort, which carries on until a task is finished, neither of them good or bad in itself.
concept_merge.what_it_reveals: That the quieter party in a hopeful exchange is not the less involved one, and that calm is not evidence of detachment. Where the film could not go is the ranking itself: the digest records it as unexplained in the sources and needing an expert check, so it could only ever have been shown, never stated.

concept_links.why: The digest's own story seed is a trading street where practised dealers and first-time sellers meet, and it ties the calm-beside-hopeful contrast to the sources' sorting of greed-rooted minds by joyful and neutral feeling, and to their ranking of neutral above joyful [C006-P:L74] [C006-M:L19]. The digest flags that ranking as unexplained and needing an expert check, and warns that portraying dealers as predatory would be defamatory in effect.

Decision is described as the mind settling firmly on an object, rightly or wrongly, and effort as what does not turn back until a task is done [C021-P:L45] [C021-M:L19]. A practised appraisal is a plain instance of both, and they carry no moral colour of their own.

what_the_viewer_could_understand: The person who looks calm in a bargain is not wanting less than the person who looks hopeful. Flat, unexcited wanting is still wanting, and it is the harder kind to notice.
what_must_be_real: A real find, a real family's stake and a real trade. No price, appraisal or negotiation arranged, and no dealer's livelihood risked by what is shown.
position_hint: middle, if ever revived: it belongs with the group's joyless-wanting beat rather than with its refusals.
risks: Portraying dealers as predatory, which would be defamatory in effect
Exposing a family's financial hardship without full understanding on their part
Real prices carry commercial sensitivity for everyone involved
Asserting the sources' ranking of flat over joyful wanting, which the digest flags for expert check
drop_if: No dealer will allow real appraisals and prices to be part of the film
A family's hardship cannot be shown with dignity and full understanding

connections.note: Its substance now sits inside IDEA-0013: the practised, unexcited half of a hopeful exchange, and the sources' ranking of flat wanting above joyful.
One trade in pricing a stone, one in shaping it.

selection.reason: Its contrast between a hopeful seller and a practised, unexcited buyer, and the sources' ranking of flat wanting above joyful, are folded into IDEA-0013, which carries the same pairing in a daily trade at far lower cost to the people in it.

unknowns: No participant or event has been found or confirmed. Everything here is a research direction.
evidence_class_note: Editorial proposal. No location, scene or shot decisions are made at the idea stage.
